items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 4 August 2026 9:56pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 04 August 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Slow moving area of low pressure over Scotland as various frontal zones affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, quickly veering west or southwest and increasing 5 or 6 later in the night. Further increasing 6 or 7 tomorrow before veering west 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate tomorrow and occasionally rough in the east later.


##Weather##

Showers continuing to clear to the east then becoming mainly fair. Further rain or showers developing later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 Thursday morning, backing west or southwest 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers until later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.
